label: 仰卧卷腹
pose_lead: Grounded pose, supine with a crunch:
lower_limbs: Both knees bend with the soles on or near the ground, the two legs roughly parallel.
upper_limbs: Both hands rest behind the head, the elbows opening to the sides.
torso_head: Head, shoulders and upper back leave the ground, the abdomen tightening; the lower back stays close to the floor.
weight_silhouette: A classic abdominal-effort shape; weight falls on the pelvis, the lower back and both feet.
